subject: Confidential: Advocacy dossier for Rohan Mehta — committee availability & evidence walkthrough
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Susie Chan <susie.chan@talentworks.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Confidential: Advocacy dossier for Rohan Mehta — committee availability & evidence walkthrough

Team —

I attached the first draft of Rohan's advocacy dossier for the upcoming level review. This is a confidential packet (internal distribution only). High-level asks: please review the write-up, confirm endorsements, and flag any factual/comp issues by EOD Wednesday so I can produce a redlined packet for the committee.

Immediate items I need from each of you:
- Marcus: add your calibration note on cross-team impact (1 paragraph) and confirm the target level recommendation (Senior Staff Eng vs Principal).
- Laura: can you compile the 1:1 feedback excerpts into the peer_feedback_summary.xlsx (I put a template tab in the sheet)?
- Neha: please confirm there are no org conflicts or active pip considerations, and if compensation comps are needed, add to comp_matrix_redacted.csv (redacted fields only).

Committee window: the review committee has availability on Feb 10 (10:00–12:00 PT), Feb 11 (13:00–16:00 PT), and Feb 12 (09:00–11:00 PT). We should aim for a 30-minute slot for advocacy + 15 minutes for Q&A. Indicate 3 ranks of preference and any blackout windows.

Attachments (stubs):
- RMehta_advocacy_draft_v1.pdf (pdf, 420KB) — draft narrative + role history
- peer_feedback_summary.xlsx (xlsx, 88KB) — template + some collected quotes
- comp_matrix_redacted.csv (csv, 14KB) — redacted benchmark data (salary fields masked)

Process note: per HR guidance, do not circulate this outside the recipients. Susie from TalentWorks is copied to help with timeline and DocuSign routing for signoffs (Susie is external and bound by our NDA for this packet).

If anything is missing in the packet you'd like me to pull (metrics, oncall logs, ticket impact) call it out and I'll prioritize.

Thanks —

Tessa Morgan
Director, Engineering — Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Susie Chan <susie.chan@talentworks.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Confidential: Advocacy dossier for Rohan Mehta — committee availability & evidence walkthrough

Tessa —

Thanks — I skimmed the draft and it looks solid. I will:
- populate peer_feedback_summary.xlsx with the 6 recent peer excerpts (I have them saved).
- add a short bullets section on delivery and mentoring impact (1/2 page).

Availability: my ranked preferences are Feb 11 (afternoon 14:00 PT), Feb 10 (10:30 PT), Feb 12 (09:30 PT). I have a blocking all-hands on Feb 10 at noon, so morning is best.

One small edit request: please strip the raw salary numbers from comp_matrix_redacted.csv — the redacted file still has ranges in the comments. Happy to scrub and re-upload.

Laura
SVP, Product (acting)
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Confidential: Advocacy dossier for Rohan Mehta — committee availability & evidence walkthrough

Tessa / team —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes from my side:
- Recommendation: endorse Rohan for promotion to Senior Staff Engineer (not Principal) based on cross-team platform impact and the new runtime initiative where he led the KV cache redesign. I'll add a 1-paragraph calibration note in the doc (will try to keep <200 words).
- Availability: my preferences are Feb 10 (10:00 PT), Feb 12 (09:30 PT), Feb 11 (15:00 PT).
- Comp note: I agree with keeping raw comp numbers redacted. Marcus (me) will add anonymized comparator bands to comp_matrix_redacted.csv and will not include absolute salary figures.

One process question: if the committee pushes back on level, are we able to request a follow-up calibration meeting? I can be there to advocate.

Marcus
Head of Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Thanks for the heads-up and for keeping this confidential. A couple process items from TalentWorks / HR ops:
- Please upload the final packet to the secure folder I shared (link below) — do not email the final packet.
- For sign-off, we will route a DocuSign to the required approvers after the committee decision; please confirm the approver list once the slot is scheduled.
- I attached the internal checklist for promotion packet completeness; fields marked "HR verify" must be present.

Link: https://secure.talentworks.com/packets/redwood/RMehta
Attachment stub: promotion_packet_checklist.pdf (pdf, 32KB)

I can confirm we can schedule a follow-up calibration meeting if the committee wants to revisit; that needs to be requested within 5 business days of the committee decision.

Best,
Susie Chan
Principal, Talent Operations
TalentWorks (consulting)

Thanks everyone — quick status:
- Laura uploaded peer_feedback_summary.xlsx (v2) — good coverage of recent project feedback, I pulled 4 quotes into the narrative.
- Marcus uploaded his calibration paragraph and anonymized comp bands.
- Neha confirmed no conflicts and cleared the packet on org-placement.

Committee slot confirmed: Feb 11, 14:00–14:45 PT (30-minute advocacy + 15 min Q&A). Meeting invite will go out to committee members only — I'll send the secure folder link and the final packet after I incorporate Marcus's minor edits.

Approvers list for DocuSign routing after committee: Laura Bennett, Marcus Lin, Tessa Morgan. Susie, please queue the DocuSign to those three if the committee approves.

Final attachment notes: I've attached the redlined final PDF here (stub) and the secure links above. Remember: do not forward.

Attachments (stubs): RMehta_advocacy_final_redlined.pdf (pdf, 460KB)

Appreciate the quick turnaround on this.

Tessa Morgan
Director, Engineering — Platform
Redwood Inference
